notes: §1985:IX.3.2.2 prints the indexed file description entry: FD file-name-1, [BLOCK CONTAINS [integer-1 TO] integer-2 {RECORDS | CHARACTERS}], [RECORD {CONTAINS integer-3 CHARACTERS | IS VARYING IN SIZE [[FROM integer-4] [TO integer-5] CHARACTERS] [DEPENDING ON data-name-1] | CONTAINS integer-6 TO integer-7 CHARACTERS}], [LABEL {RECORD IS | RECORDS ARE} {STANDARD | OMITTED}], [VALUE OF {implementor-name-1 IS {data-name-2 | literal-1}} ...], [DATA {RECORD IS | RECORDS ARE} {data-name-3} ...] and one period. PARTIAL: the entry, the BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD and DATA RECORDS shapes, the closed clause list and the once-only brackets are implemented at 85; the operands of LABEL RECORDS and the shape of VALUE OF are not. Implemented (read, and probed at 85 over an indexed file): fileDescriptionEntry requires FD, file-name-1 and the period, and fileDescriptionClause takes the clauses in any order (§1985:IX.3.2.3 SR2); BindFileSection decides the entry's format from the SELECT's organization and FileDescriptionClauseAdmitted refuses, from the Rows table, the clauses the indexed format does not print (CODE-SET, LINAGE, REPORT, FORMAT and the file control entry's clauses, COBOL2604), the table's indexed column being the 1985 list plus the EXTERNAL and GLOBAL clauses of §1985:X.4.2.2; VisitUnrecognizedClause refuses any other word (RECORDING MODE, COBOL1970) and ScreenClauseRepetition a second BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL, VALUE OF or DATA clause (COBOL2423); blockContainsClause and recordClause parse the three RECORD forms with each optional word (CONTAINS, IS, IN, SIZE, FROM, ON, CHARACTERS) written or dropped, BindRecordClause and BindBlockContainsClause bind them, the Slots table refuses a zero integer (COBOL2386), a data-name in an integer position is refused (COBOL1547) and VisitRecordClause refuses the 2023 BYTES spelling (COBOL0900). 15 legal entries compile and run; 30 malformed ones are refused. One reading settled on the printed page (IX-16, rendered): in the BLOCK CONTAINS brace RECORDS is underlined and CHARACTERS is not, as in §1985:VII.3.3.2, so BLOCK CONTAINS 20 selects CHARACTERS by omission (§1985:IV.2.1.4) and the grammar's optional word is right; the transcription and the catalog row underline CHARACTERS here, which the page does not. Not implemented: labelRecordsClause takes any run of user-defined words in place of STANDARD or OMITTED, and valueOfClause is (cobolWord | literal | IS)+ with no pairing of implementor-name-1 with its operand; no binder member reads either clause (BindFileSection has no arm for them), so every such entry compiles clean. The witness is an accepted entry with BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD CONTAINS, LABEL RECORDS ARE STANDARD and DATA RECORD IS, run for its output.

next.reason: 1985 indexed FD: BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD (CONTAINS / VARYING / integer-6 TO integer-7), LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF, DATA RECORDS. §2023:13.4.5.2 Format 2 (relative-or-indexed) keeps FD file-name-1, BLOCK CONTAINS (restated in §2023:13.18.10.2) and record-clause (§2023:13.18.43.2, which also admits BYTES), but carries no LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF or DATA RECORDS clause: a 1985 program using them (obsolete in 1985) is refused under 2023. EXTERNAL and GLOBAL are not new, 1985 X.4.2.2 already had them; only EXTERNAL AS literal-1 is. Compile-time only.
